press_references.value: Synchron and Nvidia set sights on AI model trained by direct brain activity

partnership_announcements.description: Synchron and Nvidia are collaborating to develop an AI model trained on neural data from Synchron's brain-computer interface devices. The project aims to create a cognitive AI model, Chiral, using Nvidia's Holoscan platform for real-time processing. This initiative seeks to empower individuals with disabilities by improving communication and motor control through advanced AI technology.

press_references.value: Synchron To Achieve First Native Brain-Computer Interface Integration with iPhone, iPad and Apple Vision Pro

product_launches.description: Synchron will be the first BCI company to achieve native integration with Apple's new BCI Human Interface Device (BCI HID) protocol, allowing users with Synchron's implantable BCI to control iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro with their thoughts. Controlled rollouts with trial participants using BCI HID-compatible features are expected to begin later this year.
